essence: The placement of power is itself a form of ritual action.
The thumb, index finger, and snap together form the weapon gesture.
The practitioner is to make the eightfold city as the Bhairavi body.
The form should be created by mere remembrance alone.
The invoked beings are characterized as terrible, valiant, and fierce heroes.
